name: Ajar
soft_passes: #9 era: liquid-glass classification is Big-Sur-adjacent; glass reading rests on wedge translucency (base tints toward field) + specular lower rim, both extrapolated at 256px
#10 variant robustness: monochromatic single-hue composition means dark/clear/tinted survival is inferred not verified; glyph is luminance-defined which should carry, but no layered source to confirm
#2 grid: base-heavy mass sits in lower third, optically centred via wide anchoring base, not geometrically centred
#4 16px squint: silhouette holds; specular rim + contact shadow lost by menu-bar size (acceptable, silhouette carries)
light_model: top-down soft; field and wedge both ramp light-at-top; short subtle contact shadow under wedge base; specular refraction rim on wedge lower curve + apex sheen
layer_stack: translucent lavender glass wedge (own top-down ramp)
specular edge-highlight on wedge lower curve + apex
devices: wedge-as-lid-ajar (laptop side profile, lid at an angle — the literal subject)
double-read glyph (same wedge = upward arrow/mountain = light rises with the lid)
curved-belly base with specular keel (convex bottom + refraction rim, not a flat triangle base)
monochromatic single-hue tint system (glyph is a lighter value of the field, no second hue)
rhymes_hint: single-glyph-on-single-hue-gradient utility icons; periwinkle/indigo glass-wedge family; Big-Sur-descended minimalist geometric-glyph icons quoting one abstract shape rather than a literal tool
notes: Resolution: 256x256 downsized web render, not a 1024 master — ramps and specular rim readable, 16px degradation and per-layer glass effects extrapolated. Squircle mask baked into alpha (pre-masked, transparent corners) so full-bleed square source layers cannot be confirmed, only that composition respects the mask. Era is liquid-glass but honestly Big-Sur-adjacent (single glyph on gradient); the glass evidence is the translucent wedge tinting toward the field at its base plus the specular lower rim. Monochromatic hue = tinted/dark variant robustness inferred not verified. Strong brand coherence: on the cover the icon's indigo squircle is the ONLY colour against an otherwise white/black Swiss-minimal sheet — the icon carries the entire brand hue. Subject-mined device: the app reads laptop lid angle, and the wedge is a lid ajar / a laptop side profile, doubling as an upward light-rising arrow.
